intent_text: Auth cookies leaked across subdomain boundary after rollout.
evidence_excerpt: Support logs showed session cookies accepted by unintended subdomain path.
corrective_action: Restrict cookie domain/scope and add boundary regression tests.

intent_text: Privilege template changes bypassed approval workflow in one path.
evidence_excerpt: Change event entered active state without signed second approver token.
corrective_action: Route all privilege updates through approval gate with policy enforcement.

intent_text: Rust service entered timeout loop due aggressive retry boundary.
evidence_excerpt: Circuit metrics showed rapid retry bursts with no backoff spread.
root_cause: Retry loop lacked jitter and max-attempt cap.
corrective_action: Add exponential jittered backoff and capped retries.

intent_text: Go async worker dropped cancellation context at queue handoff.
evidence_excerpt: Worker traces continued processing after upstream cancellation signal.
root_cause: Context value not propagated through handoff struct.
corrective_action: Propagate context through queue payload and enforce cancellation checks.

intent_text: Java reconciliation flow persisted stale ledger snapshots.
evidence_excerpt: Retry path read old snapshot and overwrote fresh state.
root_cause: Transaction isolation boundary insufficient for reconcile workflow.
corrective_action: Raise isolation and add optimistic lock boundary checks.

intent_text: PHP notification rendering path skipped escaping in fallback template.
evidence_excerpt: Fallback template branch interpolated raw fields into HTML.
root_cause: Template policy not centralized across renderers.
corrective_action: Centralize rendering sanitizer and forbid raw interpolation.

intent_text: C++ queue consumer hit race on shutdown boundary causing crash.
evidence_excerpt: Shutdown callback released queue resource before worker join completed.
root_cause: Lifecycle boundary order incorrect under concurrent shutdown.
corrective_action: Enforce deterministic shutdown sequence and ownership contracts.

intent_text: C frame parser integer wrap bypassed bounds check.
evidence_excerpt: Fuzz repro triggered wrap on length addition then out-of-range read.
root_cause: Unchecked integer arithmetic before bounds validation.
corrective_action: Use checked arithmetic helpers and precondition bounds guards.

intent_text: Python queue producer emitted incompatible event schema version.
evidence_excerpt: Consumer rejected events missing required discriminator field.
root_cause: Schema contract boundary not validated in CI.
corrective_action: Add producer schema contract checks against consumer fixtures.

intent_text: Ruby job dedupe window too short caused duplicate sends.
evidence_excerpt: Repeat jobs outside short dedupe window re-sent same payload.
root_cause: Dedupe boundary duration misaligned with retry profile.
corrective_action: Extend dedupe window and enforce idempotency token store.

intent_text: SQL query plan regression increased tail latency after index change.
evidence_excerpt: Explain plan switched from index scan to bitmap heap under new stats.
root_cause: Index boundary decision not validated against production cardinalities.
corrective_action: Add explain-plan acceptance gate in migration review.

intent_text: React modal stack order regression broke escape-to-close semantics.
evidence_excerpt: User interaction logs show escape consumed by wrong modal layer.
root_cause: Modal boundary ownership not deterministic in nested flows.
corrective_action: Implement modal manager boundary with explicit z-order contract.

intent_text: TypeScript input validation gap allowed malformed payload state transitions.
evidence_excerpt: Malformed enum value bypassed parser fallback and reached write path.
root_cause: Runtime validation boundary not enforced before mapper layer.
corrective_action: Require schema validation at ingress and typed mapper boundaries.

intent_text: Next.js revalidate tag omission left stale profile card after update.
evidence_excerpt: Profile segment did not receive invalidation on mutation completion.
root_cause: Tag boundary coverage incomplete for dependent route segments.
corrective_action: Audit and enforce tag mapping for all profile dependencies.

intent_text: Go webhook handler processed out-of-order retries without guardrail.
evidence_excerpt: Event sequence markers showed stale retry overwriting newer state.
root_cause: Ordering boundary check missing in idempotency layer.
corrective_action: Store sequence boundary and reject stale replay events.

intent_text: Rust FFI boundary returned opaque error codes without recovery map.
evidence_excerpt: Caller treated unknown code as retriable and amplified failure loop.
root_cause: Error contract boundary not explicit across FFI layer.
corrective_action: Define typed error map and recovery policy at FFI boundary.
